payload.thirtySeconds: KeithK75 took the net title by two shots over IUDoc92 and Dan94, and somehow also won gross while everybody else was busy donating balls to Shaftesbury Glen. The leaderboard was tight at the top, but the real story was KeithK75’s usual tee-to-green backbone showing up again while the rest of the field spent the day auditioning for a bunker-themed tragicomedy.
payload.latestTournamentTeaser: KeithK75 wins both boards while Shaftesbury Glen ate everyone else alive
payload.stateOfLeague: This event reinforces that the top of the board still runs through KeithK75 when the round turns into a grind, and it keeps the usual suspects from the upper tier in the mix without changing the fact that this league can absolutely turn into a faceplant factory when one hole goes sideways.
